title: Program ENIAC: Our New Touch-Screen Exhibit
description:
Meet the newest exhibit at the Vintage Computer Federation museum: a touch screen where you get to program ENIAC, the room-sized computer of 1946. This video walks you through it, from the live attract screen to the full Squares mission.

The touch screen is on the museum floor and still being tested with visitors.
